The '''IPG-X1131 LongTail''' was a [[podracer]] model owned by [[Teemto Pagalies]].<ref name="DB" /> The name could also refer to a type of podracer engine.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> During the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] in [[32 BBY]], it was destroyed by [[Tusken Raider]]s during the second lap.<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref>
